name: 3200 GT
description: The Maserati 3200 GT (1998–2002) was the first Maserati developed under Ferrari ownership. Styled by Giugiaro with distinctive boomerang tail-lights, it used a twin-turbocharged 3.2-litre V8 producing 370 hp. The 3200 GT signalled Maserati's commercial revival and laid the platform for the Quattroporte V.
